correctness.rationale: An exact star-edge parity reduction maps all 21 edge frequencies onto 15 internal-edge frequencies with 64 lifts, while matching 2640 degree-three regular orientations. The independent 2^21 orientation-cube integer transform was recomputed from the actual edge definition and agreed at every listed histogram bin: 1,543,168 zeros, 553,984 nonzero, min |W|16, max2640. Independent Walsh transform of the nonzero-support mask yielded full kernel absolute sum 91,381,760, divided by 2^21 =11155/256; the 15D quotient form is 1,427,840/32768. Translation conjugacy averaging proves optimality of this Fourier projection among all projections, not just translation-equivariant ones. Both source checker scripts and its finite certificate inspected. The computation exhausts the entire specified finite domain.
